sophie-sales: Quick preflight  Prospect: Harborline wants a 9-day POC. Requirements: Okta SSO (SP-initiated + metadata), SCIM for users + groups (bulk seed + delta), RBAC mapping from groups, and domain proof for 4 subdomains across 2 DNS zones. They attached a security questionnaire. Need: SCIM delta behavior & rate limits, multi-zone TXT approach, delegated admin scope, and a ballpark Dedicated POC price. @dan-se @kevin-eng @lina-ops

dan-se: TL;DR: We support SP-initiated SAML and will accept IdP metadata as URL or XML. SCIM 2.0 supported; recommended flow is bulk import to seed (paged) + PATCH-based deltas for incremental updates. Group->role mapping is native; you can configure a group allowlist so only specific groups provision roles.

kevin-eng: SCIM detail: delta uses PATCH ops, our webhook/delta feed surfaces only changed resources. Default Hosted SCIM throttle is 60 req/s (can be raised temporarily for POCs on request). For big migrations use bulk with pageSize ~500-1000 then switch to delta. Example PATCH we accept: ```PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":true}]
}```

kevin-eng: Note: if Okta sends many groups in SAML assertions it can increase assertion size; prefer SCIM groups for orgs with large group sets.

lina-ops: Domain proof: we emit a TXT token per (sub)domain. If multiple subdomains live under the same DNS zone we can optionally provide a consolidated TXT (ops-approved) to reduce work, but separate zones/providers require separate TXT records. We don't support wildcard apex verification. Verification usually finishes within minutes of DNS propagation; schedule a 24h buffer. If they give DNS readonly access we can run verification ourselves to speed the kickoff.

sophie-sales: Delegated admin question: can customer provide tenant-scoped admins to manage SSO/SCIM and domain claims?

dan-se: Yes  tenant-scoped admin roles available. For Dedicated/Private they can manage SSO config, SCIM toggles, group allowlists, and initiate domain claims; Hosted supports tenant admins but ops may run final verification depending on method.

omar-legal: Security packet checklist: SOC2 Type II summary, pen-test exec summary, encryption-at-rest + KMS note, SAML endpoints & required attributes, SCIM scope/retention, network isolation whitepaper (for Dedicated), and our standard DPA. If they return the questionnaire we'll fill and flag any redlines for legal.

lina-ops: Pricing route: quick option = Hosted with elevated quotas + credits; heavier option = short Dedicated trial. For the POC scale they described (~150k tokens/day, moderate concurrency) ballpark Dedicated trial = $2,600/week (sales-ops to confirm).

sophie-sales: I'll request IdP metadata (XML/URL), sample SAML assertion, SCIM service token + one test user, list of domains with DNS providers, and the filled security questionnaire. Will share quote EOD. :thumbsup:
